source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football: Jacory Croskey-Merritt among Justin Boone's top sleeper picks at RB
source.author: Justin Boone

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone targets Croskey-Merritt as an inexpensive potential lead back with difference-making upside.
takeaways.rationale: He enters the season atop Washington's depth chart, flashed during the 2025 fantasy playoffs, reportedly improved as a receiver, and draws a favorable running back schedule.
risks: Rachaad White should handle passing-down work
A larger all-purpose role still has to be earned

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone sees Mason as an affordable back who could lead Minnesota's tandem or gain major value if Aaron Jones misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Mason produced as a fantasy RB2 when Jones was absent and is generating lead-back buzz in an offense expected to rebound.
risks: Demond Claiborne could enter the rotation if injuries strike

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone views Gainwell as a weekly RB3/flex with immediate top-15 upside if Bucky Irving misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Gainwell is coming off a productive receiving season and handled starter-level workloads effectively when called upon.
risks: His initial role is behind Bucky Irving
Sean Tucker may absorb some work if Irving is unavailable
